items.claim: Lemos has lost her recent fights against strong pressure grapplers.
items.quote: Lemos has lost back-to-back fights against strong pressure grapplers.

items.claim: Grasso has the style to give Lemos trouble with takedowns.
items.quote: she's got the style to give Lemos, a 39-year-old Lemos, a lot of trouble with takedowns.

items.claim: Lemos has okay takedown defense and knows some recovery mechanics, but never really puts it all together against grapplers.
items.quote: She has okay takedown defense. She knows how to split the legs and face the face the hand and get some wrist control, but she never really puts it all together.
